question: Can I automatically see any restricted record held by the Provincial Archives of Saskatchewan?
generated_answer: No, you cannot automatically see restricted records held by the Provincial Archives of Saskatchewan. Restricted records are those that are closed to the public due to privacy, legal, or other reasons. To access restricted records, you would need to submit a request to the Archives, providing justification for why you need access to the records. The Archives will then review your request and determine whether access can be granted. This process may involve obtaining permission from the record creator or their heirs, or complying with specific legal requirements. It's important to note that not all restricted records can be made available, even with a request. The Archives will always prioritize protecting privacy and complying with applicable laws and regulations.
